title: CONVERT TO SCALAR, COPY MAPPING, ETC
description:
Take an existing cifti file and change one of the mappings.  Exactly one of -series, -scalar, or -from-cifti must be specified.  The direction can be either an integer starting from 1, or the strings 'ROW' or 'COLUMN'.

The argument to -unit must be one of the following:

SECOND
HERTZ
METER
RADIAN

data_cifti.description: the cifti file to use the data from

direction.description: which direction on <data-cifti> to replace the mapping

template_cifti.description: a cifti file containing the desired mapping

direction.description: which direction to copy the mapping from

from_cifti.description: copy mapping from another cifti file
